nico (SRE Lead): Heads-up: control-plane network maintenance scheduled Tue 2026-06-15 02:00–02:45 UTC. Expected impact: short-lived routing flaps during IP switchover — we anticipate transient 5–15% error spikes for hosted API and Dedicated control-plane routed requests. Plan: rolling node drains, warm-up, and automated rollback if errors >20% for >5m. Runbook pinned below.

maria (SRE): Do we want to adjust SLO burn-rate or mark this as planned maintenance for customers?

nico (SRE Lead): Yes — we'll apply temporary SLO tolerance and mark a scheduled maintenance window on status.redwood.ai. No SLA credit changes, just an expected maintenance annotation. I'll flip the maintenance flag 30m before.

kevin (EngRuntime): Warm-up plan: we'll prefill KV cache and run a short generator warmup against canaries in each AZ. Script to run from ops jump hosts: 

```bash
for m in gpt-small-3 gpt-medium-3; do
  for i in {1..30}; do
    curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/warmup 
      -H 'Authorization: Bearer $WARMUP_KEY' 
      -d '{"model":"'$m'","prompt":"warmup token"}' &
  done
  wait
done
```

This primes KV cache and will keep latp95 low. Also will hit /healthcheck endpoints after each drain step.

jess (ProdOps): I'll draft the status page message and send a customer advisory to enterprise seats 3h before. Template: "Planned maintenance: control-plane network switchover, brief degraded routing expected." Want to loop in Sales for any VIP customers?

alexa (PM): Please cc Dedicated account owners and include recommended mitigation (pin to specific model versions or use Dedicated capacity if worried).

sanjay (Support): Can we have an ops channel open during the window (e.g., #ops-maint-1859987654) so Support can triage in real time? Also want the expected error types (429 vs 503).

nico (SRE Lead): I'll open #ops-maint-1859987654 10m before maintenance and pin the runbook. Expected transient errors will be `503` and occasional `504` for long tails; 429 should be rare unless throttles kick in.

kevin (EngRuntime): Quick checklist I'm attaching here (paste into runbook):
- Pre-warm KV caches in each AZ (30 requests/model/host)
- Pause non-critical background jobs touching control plane
- Sequentially drain control-plane nodes with 60s cooldown
- Run smoke tests: `curl /healthz` and `curl /v1/generate` against canary tokens
- Monitor latency & 5xx rate in datadog dash `cp-maint-1859987654`

jess (ProdOps): Added: post-maint validation steps (token sampling, synthetic rate test at 50 rps for 5m).

deploy-bot: Reminder created — scheduled maintenance reminder will notify #eng-sre and #prodops 30 minutes prior.

sanjay (Support): Acks. I'll prepare canned replies for support tickets (one-liner + ETA).

maria (SRE): I'll own the rollback threshold and watch the burn rate. If errors >20% sustained for 5m, we abort and re-route to fallback region.

nico (SRE Lead): Final notes: this is low-risk but loud. Keep messages short, call out customer impact in bullet form, and pin postmortem template in the channel. :thumbsup:

kevin (EngRuntime): Copy. Will post warmup script to runbook and start pre-warm 40m before maintenance.

jess (ProdOps): Draft ready, will schedule customer advisory now.

sanjay (Support): :thumbsup: will standby in the ops channel.

nico (SRE Lead): All set. If anything unexpected, start the abort play and notify exec-oncall. I'll update the thread with final go/no-go 15m before start.
